summary: The root "nzf" primarily means to exhaust something completely, like draining a well of its water. It implies a thorough depletion.
lane: 1 نَزَفَ ذ He entirely exhausted (S, Msb, K) a well, (Msb,) or the water of a well. (S, K.)
